name: Wallenius Wilhelmsen ASA
summary: Wallenius Wilhelmsen ASA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the logistics and transportation business worldwide. It operates in three segments: Shipping Services, Logistics Services, and Government Services. The company provides ship management services, including crewing, technical, and management; insurance brokerage services; agency services; freight and liner services; and marine products to vessels. It also offers ocean transport of RoRo cargo, breakbulk and vehicles, as well as manufacturers, construction, and other high and heavy equipment.
